title: petalTongue Unification — ZK Cut All Surfaces into ONE

current_state.design: UniBin — 1 binary, 7 subcommands (ui, tui, web, headless, server, live, status)

features.ui: egui/eframe — OpenGL/Vulkan native GUI (64,148 lines, 323 files)

unification_plan.principle: petal-tongue-scene IS the ONE renderer. All surfaces compile scene → output.
zk_cut: Scene graph defines the WHAT (topology, data, layout)
Each surface is a COMPILER from scene → pixels/characters/bytes
UI compiler: scene → egui draw calls (still separate for GPU rendering)
TUI compiler: scene → ratatui widgets (character grid)
what_melts: 64K lines of UI-specific layout logic → shared scene layout
Duplicate data fetching in each surface → unified DataService (already exists)
Per-surface state management → scene graph IS the state
Custom widget implementations → scene primitives that compile everywhere
unification_plan.usb_note: Scene graph serializes to JSON. JSON flows over USB/ADB. grapheneGate renders locally. The spine IS the scene.

devices_it_runs_on.northGate: RTX 5090 + egui (ui mode) — full GPU rendering
devices_it_runs_on.eastGate: RTX 4070 + egui or tui — gate display
devices_it_runs_on.deckGate: RDNA 2 + Steam Deck display — console mode
devices_it_runs_on.frameGate: Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 + ARM SteamOS — face display
devices_it_runs_on.graftGate: M4 GPU + egui — Mac Mini display
